stopWidenRationale: All five targeted cancellation seeds returned up to the per-source limit of 20 DataForSEO ideas. The free question sweeps returned 37 cancellation and 32 gym suggestions; exact-query live PAA provided six questions (five on-topic) and the direct target appeared in Autocomplete. Narrower biller/service families and comparison/pricing intents were checked; the latter are excluded. No additional paid expansion was justified for this single decision-aid scope. The legal examples are intentionally selected rather than comprehensive; widen legal research only if Phase 3 findings show the tool otherwise implies complete state coverage.
volumeCaveat: Autocomplete rows are estimates, not measured search volume. DataForSEO volumes are rounded/bucketed; no post counts or awareness percentages were derived.
